level8_best_progress: Best single-episode state: 11 of 13 blocks simultaneously placed in bays (episode 3, with a 12th in helper transit and the 13th on the ground at timer expiry). South zone was fully completed (5/5, permanent) in both episodes 2 and 3 after the south thief was eliminated.
action_sequence_note: No winning sequence found; no candidate to gate. The three L8 episode logs (150 actions each after the 477-prefix) are preserved in this artifact for replay-study but none reaches level 8.
novel_hypothesis_tested: L8 is the final-exam level: two zones (north/south) joined by two wall-band gaps, EACH with a color-12 HELPER and a color-15 THIEF, 13 blocks, decoy pad fields, and two multi-slot bays. Key discoveries: (1) LADEN-DISMISSAL IS SAFE -- ACTION5 on a laden thief removes it and its cargo drops in place as a normal block (proven twice: north thief killed at tick 9, south thief in episode 2); (2) thieves ACTIVELY FLEE the player (interleaved move after every player action), so open-field chases never connect -- kills only land when the thief walks INTO the players adjacency on its own deterministic dump-run, making CAMP-AND-WAIT at the zones dump patch the reliable kill method (south patch: tiles around (12,4),(12,5),(13,5); north: (2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(4,3)); (3) under bump-pressure a laden thief ABANDONS its cargo in place; (4) thieves raid BAYS (steal placed blocks) and kite them cross-zone, so they must die before either zone can stabilize; (5) helpers never despawn, counter-ferry every thief dump automatically, and late-game CROSS ZONES to deliver to the other bay -- bays are fungible (any block in any bay slot counts); (6) the player yanking a PLACED bay block via a careless facing-ACTION5 is the single biggest self-inflicted hazard (happened 3 times; always repairable by immediate re-drop, since the ghost hovers over the vacated slot).
narrative: Replayed the 477-action verified prefix (8th consecutive identical replay). Episode 1 (recon): mapped both zones, watched the north thief self-remove after two dumps (later shown to be a player-adjacency dismissal artifact or steal-cap), discovered thief flee-behavior, bay raids, cross-zone kiting, and the churn equilibrium (~10-11/13) that makes out-ferrying a live thief impossible. Episode 2: proved the patch-camp kill on the south thief (laden, cargo survived), completed the south zone 5/5 permanently, and confirmed the plateau: the north thief plus remaining ferries exceed one timer. Episode 3 (double-kill blueprint): killed the north thief at tick 9 with a camp directly on its first dump-run -- the cleanest kill of the session -- then hunted the south thief through raid/kite/dump cycles (recovered its hostages twice via bump-pressure abandons), eliminated it late, and sprinted ferries with both helpers unopposed: 11 of 13 placed at expiry, one in transit, one stranded. The level is clearly winnable in one episode with the refined script (kill north at tick 9, kill south at its FIRST dump ~tick 8-14 by camping the south patch immediately -- the two camps are compatible if the player takes the south gap first and sacrifices the north tick-9 window for a tick-25 one, or accepts the north thiefs 2-dump damage while camping south), leaving ~90 ticks of unopposed 3-worker ferrying for 13 blocks -- feasible against the ~125-action timer. Budget exhausted before a fourth episode fit (927/1000 with the artifact-writing margin reserved).
l8_gotchas: LADEN-DISMISSAL SAFE: ACTION5 on a laden thief kills it; cargo drops in place (no despawn).
Thieves flee the player 1-tile-per-interleave: never chase in open field; camp their deterministic dump patch and strike when they walk adjacent.
South thief dump patch: (12,4)/(12,5)/(13,5)/(14,5); north: (2,3)/(2,4)/(3,3)/(4,3). Dumps land on the SAME tiles every cycle.
Bump-pressure on a laden thief forces a cargo abandon -- the recovered block is immediately ferry-able.
Thieves raid bays and kite blocks cross-zone; no zone stabilizes while its thief lives.
Helpers never despawn, auto-counter-ferry all dumps, and cross zones late-game: bays are fungible across zones.
NEVER press ACTION5 while facing a placed bay block: three self-yanks this session (all repaired by instant re-drop onto the hovered slot).
Ghost-trail drops land one tile short of the intended slot when a mid-carry move gets blocked by crossing NPCs: verify position before every drop; the fix costs 4 actions (re-pick, shift, drop).
Zone gaps: north band row 6 gap at cols 4-5; south band row 9 gap at cols 9-10.
recommended_next_session_plan: Single-episode script (~120 actions): (1) rush south gap, camp (13,5) by tick ~16, kill the south thief on its second dump-run (~tick 18-24, proven geometry); (2) cross to the north camp (4,4)/(3,4), kill the north thief at its next patch visit (~tick 35-45; it will have made 2-3 dumps -- all recoverable); (3) ferry with both helpers unopposed, prioritizing the far quad blocks while helpers take near ones; bays are fungible so deliver everything to the nearest bay. Expected completion ~tick 110-120 of the ~125 budget. Alternative if tight: two episodes with the first dedicated purely to a double-kill speedrun to characterize exact kill ticks, second to execute.
